Net profit = net sales − net COGS − ad spend (order date; ad spend on delivery date). Date axis: order_date (IST); grain: brand_order_day_channel_ad. Redefined in semantic v2 (version 2.0.0): until v2 the id net_profit meant the event-date P&L number, now pnl_net_profit.
Net sales ex-GST on ORDER date (cancelled / RTO → 0). The Finance P&L number on event date is pnl_net_sales. Date axis: order_date (IST); grain: order.

New customers = first orders placed, by order date. Date axis: order_date (IST); grain: order.

Operating cost = shipping + packaging + gateway fees + RTO (order date). Date axis: order_date (IST); grain: brand_order_day_channel_ad. Redefined in semantic v2 (version 2.0.0): until v2 the id operating_cost meant the event-date P&L number, now pnl_operating_cost.
Ad spend by delivery date on the order-date P&L (the spend deducted from contribution margin to give net profit). Date axis: order_date (IST); grain: brand_order_day_channel_ad.
Revenue of the orders placed that were cancelled (order date, P&L basis); deducted from gross sales. Date axis: order_date (IST); grain: brand_order_day_channel_ad.
Discounts on the orders placed (order date, P&L basis); deducted from gross sales. Date axis: order_date (IST); grain: brand_order_day_channel_ad.
Gross sales of the orders placed (order date, P&L basis); the top line of the order-date P&L. Date axis: order_date (IST); grain: brand_order_day_channel_ad.

P&L net sales on order date = gross − discounts − returns − cancellations of the orders placed (the net sales every order-date profit, contribution margin and ROAS figure is built on). Revenue later returned on the orders placed (order date, P&L basis); deducted from gross sales. Date axis: order_date (IST); grain: brand_order_day_channel_ad.

Orders with at least one recorded touch. Date axis: order_date (IST); grain: order_touch.

Payment amount (refunds negative). Date axis: transaction_date (IST); grain: transaction.

Orders with a recognised payment bucket (cod / online / manual …). Date axis: order_date (IST); grain: order.

Net sales ex-GST = gross − discounts − returns − cancels (event date). = dashboard Net Sales. Date axis: report_date (event date); grain: brand_day_channel_ad.
Operating cost = shipping + packaging + gateway fees + RTO. Date axis: report_date (event date); grain: brand_day_channel_ad. Also the home of the v1 meaning of: operating_cost.
Packaging cost. Date axis: report_date (event date); grain: brand_day_channel_ad. Also the home of the v1 meaning of: packaging_cost.
